## Linked issue (required)

GitHub auto-closes the issue **only** when this PR merges into the default branch (`main`) and the description uses a linking keyword:

- `Fixes #<issue_number>` (preferred)
- `Closes #<issue_number>`
- `Resolves #<issue_number>`

Same-repo example: `Fixes #12`  
Cross-repo example: `Fixes owner/repo#12`

Fixes #
